Both reports are complete, with no failures, aborts or page errors. None of the 106 + 37 deterministic rows varied, and the rows on the watch list were stable.

1. In my clean, isolated run, the fade-drag commit count was 60 three times; A's clean run gave 59. The count differs between clean runs too, not just under load, which supports making those 16 rows wallclock.
2. The new test only covers the 16 drag rows and the 24 fader rows. Covering every other row's kind would be new scope.
3. The known dev-server error on first load (C-R223-OBS-01) happened again on the very first 1440 load. Two fresh contexts afterwards were clean, so it stays with the open root request.
